narrative.overview: The site inherits the existing Kindle Daybook authority: white paper, dark Manrope text, generous space, fine rules and restrained controls. The TV demonstration retains the launcher’s own Bricolage and Onest typography inside its dark screen. This is a continuation of the established visual system.
keyCharacteristics: White paper and ink with fine neutral rules.
Spacious numbered instructions and readable supporting copy.
A large, fictional TV demonstration with focus-driven color.
Natural Turkish and an English alternative.
dos: Do preserve the inherited Manrope, paper, ink and fine-rule vocabulary.
Do label fictional demonstration data visibly.
Do keep setup content readable in document flow and downloads usable without JavaScript.
Do retain keyboard focus, reduced-motion support and the exact author signature “Developed by makallete”.
donts: Don’t extend the TV’s saturated palette or glow to the surrounding page.
Don’t introduce real household data or unverified performance claims.
Don’t replace the inherited visual authority with a new identity.
